explication: Dynamoid is a Ruby ORM that maps model definitions and ActiveRecord-like operations to Amazon DynamoDB. A user defines documents and fields, builds criteria, then reads or persists records through the adapter; query execution handles expression conversion and pagination before calling DynamoDB. The repository also documents associations, validations, callbacks, Dirty tracking, type casting, and transactions. Several subsystem paths are represented from the tree and README rather than inspected source; their internal call relationships are therefore omitted.
